title: Gakuyen Ultimate Sound FX Pack
note: Hand-curated from all 38 files. Each entry names its event class, a description of what it sounds like and the moments it is for. `slice` cuts one sound out of a file that holds several (the camera files are 4-8s strings of shutters). `hit` is where the moment LANDS inside the kept audio, in seconds from its onset: the peak of a whoosh, the crest of a swell-in impact, the top of a riser. The build aligns `hit` to the cue time, so a whoosh peaks on the cut and a riser crests on the word. Leave `hit` out and it is measured (the loudest 10ms) at vendoring time.
